verdict.rationale: Shopify POS documents selling in person on iOS/Android devices and offers a hardware lineup, including POS Hub for peripherals. Tap to Pay turns a smartphone into a contactless checkout, which implies merchants can take card payments without waiting on dedicated hardware. However, nothing in the evidence describes the signup or payment approval flow, ordering hardware from the admin dashboard, or how long it takes to go live. Missing for 10: documented signup and merchant approval/onboarding flow, in-dashboard hardware ordering, same-week time-to-first-payment evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
